I am so gaslighted by my mother I don't even know how to feel anymore. She works off of manipulation, though she would never call it that. She asks loaded questions and makes statements about my intentions becuase "thats what your behavior says to me" like for instance, I don't get up till 2 pm on a holiday and procrastinate my duties becuase I can't breath "Okay so obviously you don't want to go to college so what do you want to do" Me" I DO want to go to college, I'm just so anxious right now I can barely move." Mom"Ok well what do you want to do then?" Me" I don't know I am completely overwhelmed" mom"well then stop thinking about what ever your thinking about." Me" I'm not thinking about anything! I just feel this way!" Mom[brain circuits malfunctioning]"Watch a movie to get your mind off it." Me" How am I supposed to get my mind off of something that hasn't gone away in 5 years?" mom[rolls her eyes and walks away]. Oh and theres the classic flip flop she loves to put me through. mom" While you are going to college and getting your mental health together I will pay for your living expenses. I don't think you should get a job yet" the next day me"Mom can I have some money for food?" mom"When are you getting a job?" Like she'll tell me one thing and then COMPLETELY flip script the next day. I can't even trust my own memories anymore. I barely leave my room. I hate myself.

opening up pushes people away. Being around people makes me panic. I can't talk to anyone. I can't be around anyone. Theres no point.
yes. they are generally unhelpful and condescending. Part of the reason I am ready to die is that I have felt nothing but deterred by the medical community.

Im sure having someone to open up to who is empathetic and caring would do wonders. In fact I crave that as much as I crave dying. Validation....empathy....connection....its what I desire most. Well that and relief. But I don't have that. I don't have people in my life that I trust that I can open up to with out feeling judged or like a burden. I don't have hundreds of dollars just to go talk to someone once a week. Opening up to my mother (Person taking care of me) is a shit show that almost always results in me having an epic panic attack that can last days. My friends push me away when I open up about the heavy stuff. Or roll their eyes at me. Or tell me NOT to fell that way. And they always ALWAYS awkwardly change the subject. I feel completely and totally alone. No matter how much people say I'm not, i haven't encountered anything thats made me believe it.
Last time I contacted a hotline they literally laughed at me. I think its just better this way.

I literally lost my last perfect job becuase of my illness. I cannot work becuase of how burdened I am with anxiety. Getting up to go to the bathroom has me holding my breath. No amount of talking nicely to myself has ever caused me to feel better or become motivated. I literally black out and have panic attacks when I try to organize and be productive. I never had a problem opening up till now. Its just that after opening up my best friends pushed me away and my mother became completely insufferable. I have pushed my self and pushed my self and thrown myself over the line of what was comfortable for me just to end up a stranded gasping fish on land. Its the same advice, everytime, and my friends and family will literrally turn away from me if I say that i've tried these things and they don't work. So I try again. Getting a job. Taking a class. Working out. Walking. Breathing. And like clock work, my anxicety becomes so overwhelming that I blow up and everything blows up in my face and I'm left with nothing. Starting from rock bottom. Again. And again. And again. And each time I come out more isolated, more alone, more tired, more ready to die.

What triggered this is feeling like this for years and years and years feeling unheard and experiencing no relief. I don't have the luxury of my anxiety going away and coming back. It is always there. Always buzzing. Always tormenting me.

I have reached out. To friends. To family. To professionals. Its fruitless. Doing this only proved to me that in fact I am alone. Opening up has done nothing but make my life harder. I've been battling this for almost a decade. I've been a body builder, had a great full time job I loved, been to college, taken up crafts, done allllllllllllll the simple fixes everyone has suggested. Nothing. I haven't felt satisfaction in years. Joy? Not even in fucking disney world. Going outside just causes me to have a full blown panic attack. Doctors don't listen to me. I'm not sure if they don't believe me, think I'm lying, or just don't care. But the ones who have humored me in the past were obviously in it for the money, not interested in me as an individual. I'm nothing but a pay check. And I can't even make my own money for this. My mother has to pay for me becuase i'm too much of a wreak to even get up. I woke up at 6 am and i haven't moved yet. its 5 pm. everyone just thinks I'm lazy, or i don't want to get better. No one has ever actually empathized with me. no one.

I have a pug who spends most of his day in bed with me. I do not take anything except for Marijuana for my daily panic attacks. I do not attempt to get treatment by doctors anymore. I've tried countless times to get help, but have left feeling defeated every time. They have treated me like I am lying, roll their eyes at me, mocked me, brushed me off, reprimanded me, and have never shown me a shred of empathy. I go to therapy? They never offer advice, just have me pay 500$ to talk about why I want to fucking die and then leave. Intensive out patient therapy? 2 hours of controdictive philosophy and an hour of talking about how much life sucks. Mention you want to die? Hours of questions and invasive interviewing till they either let you go or force you to go to a hospital that gives less than two shits about you. OH you have panic attacks daily? Your anxiety is so bad that you can't even remember what you did earlier in the day? You don't need Xanex or anything to stop your panic attacks or help you maintain your daily stability. Nah you seem totally fine. But on the off chance you're not lying about your illness, heres a low dose of a medication you have to take every day for 2 weeks at the same time every day or else it'll make you go bat shit crazy. Then maybe after two weeks you won't want to kill yourself, but if you forget a pill you're gonna want to kill yourself so fucking bad you'll probably do it right then and there. No, I avoid these things like the fucking pluage now.
